description: This source file defines the PimReportAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for handling API requests related to PIM (Personal Information Management) reports. It extends a base ReportAPI class and provides methods for retrieving specific report instances, validation rules, and interacts with a report generator service.

classes.name: PimReportAPI
classes.description: API class for handling PIM report related requests in OrangeHRM. It retrieves reports based on report IDs, validates inputs, and utilizes services to generate reports.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Provides an instance of ReportGeneratorService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and constructs the specific report instance based on request parameters, throwing exceptions on invalid report names.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single report, including report ID validation.
